tacticalIdentity: Short-range cone burst specialist. All four base spells are cones — the Sonimancer must close to melee adjacency to use the full toolkit. Deals the highest raw DPS per AP of any Mancer at melee range, but has the shortest base range on the roster. Shatters bone constructs and FROZEN units via sonic impact.
designNotes: Hard counter to bone constructs (BONE_SPIRE destroyed by sonic attack). Requires close-range positioning. Best with mobility support from Aeromancer Updraft.

baseSpells.description: A quick directional sonic burst in a short cone (range 3). Deals 10 Sound damage and applies DEAFENED (1 turn: -2 to all spell ranges). Minimal AP cost enables double-cast.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP filler. Multiple casts per activation apply DEAFENED to multiple targets or stack with higher-AP cone spells.

baseSpells.description: A focused resonant frequency blast in a cone. Deals 25 Sound damage and applies RESONATING (tile state: subsequent sonic hits deal +5 damage, 2 turns).
baseSpells.designNotes: Primary damage tool. Seeds RESONATING terrain for Crystalomancer amplification (85% Node release instead of 70%).

baseSpells.description: Maximum-intensity sonic blast in a cone. Deals 35 Sound damage. SHATTER interaction: FROZEN or BRITTLE_ARMOR units in the cone take double sonic damage and have their frozen state shattered immediately.
baseSpells.designNotes: Signature heavy. Cryomancer FROZEN + Shatter Scream = 87 damage total (35 × 2.5 SHATTER multiplier) on a single hit.

baseSpells.description: A chaotic dissonant pulse that disrupts enemy concentration. Deals 18 Sound damage in a cone and applies SILENCE (2 turns: cannot cast spells). SILENCED units can still move and attack physically.
baseSpells.designNotes: SILENCE is the strongest indirect disable — enemy Mancer can only run, not cast, for 2 turns. Use on Necromancer to prevent summon refill.

baseSpells.description: Tunes an allied unit's body to a protective resonant frequency that bypasses physical barriers. Ally takes -2 damage from all hits (sonic dampening). The ally's attacks also apply RESONATING to targets (not just tiles). Duration: 3 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Resonance Lock bypasses Bone Armor entirely — hard counter to Osteomancer defensive buffs.
